paper_title: Ultralight vector dark matter search using data from the KAGRA O3GK run
suggested_experiment_name: KAGRA O3GK run (auxiliary length channels MICH and PRCL)
coupling_convention: ε_B-L (dimensionless coupling constant for U(1)_{B-L} gauge boson), plotted as 95% upper limit on coupling strength
notes: Paper presents 95% upper limits on U(1)_{B-L} gauge boson coupling from KAGRA O3GK run. Figure 5 shows limits on epsilon_B-L over mass range ~10^-14 to 10^-11 eV. Limits are order O(10^-20) as stated in text ('upper limit on epsilon_B-L from O3GK data will be at best O(10^-20)'). The paper explicitly states these constraints are weaker than previous experiments (Eot-Wash, MICROSCOPE) by several orders of magnitude due to short observation time (~2 weeks, max 7 hour contiguous segments) and current noise level. Mass range corresponds to frequency band O(10-1000) Hz. Encoded as horizontal line at coupling ~10^-20 spanning the stated mass range, as the limit is approximately flat across the analyzed frequency band. Confidence level 0.75 because: coupling type is unambiguous (VectorBL clearly stated), but numerical values are approximate from text statement rather than precise table values, and the limit is presented as order-of-magnitude estimate. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.92, 30)) | Vision: FIG. 5 shows 95% upper limits on the B−L gauge coupling constant ε_B−L derived from KAGRA O3GK data using MICH (blue line) and PRCL (orange line) auxiliary channels. The x-axis is frequency in Hz (10–1000 Hz range), which converts to mass via m_A [eV/c²] = 4.136×10⁻¹⁵ × f[Hz]. The y-axis shows ε_B−L on a log scale from 10⁻¹⁹ to 10⁻¹⁵. The MICH channel provides the stronger constraint (lower boundary). The boundary traced follows the MICH curve, which is the primary exclusion limit. The plot demonstrates KAGRA's unique sensitivity to vector DM due to the different compositions of its mirrors (fused silica vs. sapphire), which enhances the differential length change signal. The constraint is weaker than previous limits from Eöt-Wash torsion balance and MICROSCOPE (10⁻²⁴ to 10⁻²³) due to the limited observation time and current noise level of KAGRA during O3GK, but represents the first vector DM search using gravitational wave detector auxiliary channels. | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=0.57 snapped to identity)
